title: Next-day management admission of realized two-cell groundwater transfer

sequencing.rationale: Freeze the next-allocation-boundary handoff before observing the corrected two-cell day-1 product experiment.

relation_to_20f.reason: DUMMY-20F was explicitly bound to DUMMY-20E2, whose groundwater intervention was not realized. DUMMY-20F2 carries the same time-direction hypothesis onto the new two-cell intervention authority without rewriting DUMMY-20F.

idealized_day1_reference.meaning: 8 m3/day limiting reference retained prospectively; two-cell analytical transfer differs by less than 0.00013 m3/day.

allocation_at_24h.rationale: Accepted day-1 storage, 32 m3/day fixed source and still-active approximately 8 m3/day groundwater forcing provide enough availability for full 60 m3/day demand.

hypotheses: If DUMMY-20E3 qualifies, its first-day trajectory is the required physical prefix: groundwater transfer changes physical state without within-day management reallocation.
At the fixed allocation boundary t=24 h, the accepted day-1 Basin storage becomes management-visible.
The approximately 8 m3/day active groundwater forcing is included in the next allocation horizon.
The t=24 h decision fully allocates root=40 and external=20 m3/day.
External physical supply becomes positive only after t=24 h.
Day-2 recipient supply follows the common physical min_level reduction from the full 40/20 allocation.
The two-day coupled ledger closes at every accepted 6-hour boundary.
forbidden: no execution if DUMMY-20E3 does not qualify the nonzero intervention
no change to allocation.dt, saveat or product timestep
no post-output tuning of day-2 references
